info.title: Mister Download Manager website ratings and figures
info.summary: The star ratings visitors give Mister Download Manager on misterdownloadmanager.com, and the home page's live figures.
info.description: Visitors of misterdownloadmanager.com rate Mister Download Manager from one to five stars on the home and download pages. Anyone may read the numbers, and the home page's live figures (the downloads from GitHub, the browser add-on's users). Rating and removing a rating are for the website's own pages: they need the site's Origin and a Cloudflare Turnstile token from a person on the page. One rating per visitor, kept as a salted hash of the IP address, never the address. Source: https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/tree/main/website/ratings

externalDocs.description: How the ratings work, and the site's privacy policy

get.summary: The home page's live figures: the downloads from GitHub, the browser add-on's users
get.description: No Origin needed. `downloads`: the download_count of every file of every GitHub release, added up. `chrome`: the users the Chrome Web Store's listing shows. `firefox`: addons.mozilla.org's average daily users. Each with when it was read; a source that can't be read keeps its last good figure and that figure's time, and a figure never read is null. The sources are read again at most every 15 minutes.

get.summary: The ratings: average, count, how many gave each number of stars
get.description: No Origin needed. `mine` is the asking visitor's own rating (from the same connection), or null.

post.summary: Rate, or change the visitor's rating (the website's pages only)
post.description: Needs `Origin: https://misterdownloadmanager.com` (or www.) and a Turnstile token from the page's widget. At most 8 ratings or removals a visitor in 10 minutes.
